baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقْ at word 1 and أَزْوَاجًا at word 2
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is both origination and prior proportioning, while azwaj names counterparts that may be similar or opposite. The clause therefore presents human plurality as deliberately fitted counterpart relations, not as accidental aggregation.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies deliberate fit as the mode of creating the counterparts.
Originating and bringing into being keeps the clause anchored in an act of creation rather than mere classification.
A paired counterpart, whether similar or opposite, supplies the basic relation produced by the creative act.

changed_reading.before: We created human beings male and female.
changed_reading.after: We originated and proportioned you through fitted counterpart relations, including complementary as well as matching pairs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The creative verb خَلَقْ governs the plural noun أَزْوَاجًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spouse and active-joining branches make azwaj relational rather than merely taxonomic: creation places humans in bonds in which one is joined to another.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being supplies the originating act that establishes the relation.
The spouse image specifies marital counterparts as a direct realization of azwaj.
Joining one thing or person with another turns the noun from a static label into an enacted bond.

changed_reading.before: We created you in two sexes.
changed_reading.after: We created you into joined spousal relations, each counterpart constituted in relation to another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite plural أَزْوَاجًا can activate the kind and peer-group branches of ز و ج.
baseline_models.mechanism: Azwaj can distribute the plural addressees into kinds, varieties, or associates sharing form, action, or condition. The focus need not resolve into two-person units.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning supplies the differentiation of the created plurality into distinguishable sets.
A kind, variety, or class opens azwaj beyond binary sexual pairing.
Peers or associates grouped by shared action, form, or condition supplies a social and collective mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each human was created as one member of a dyad.
changed_reading.after: Humanity was created in multiple kinds and affinity sets, including peers joined by shared form or condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly gives a thing a prepared state or fitted function: earth is readied, mountains stabilize, sleep rests, night covers, and day sustains. Human pairedness becomes one instance of a world assembled through complementary functions.

activation_trace.role: Proportioning anchors the claim that the human relation is fitted rather than merely juxtaposed.
Paired counterparts provide the focus relation that the neighboring functions enlarge.
Rendering a thing into a state supplies the repeated assignment of distinct world-functions.
Preparing and leveling an affair makes the earth-side of the sequence a fitted enabling condition.
Upright fixity like a peg supplies the stabilizing counterfunction beside the prepared earth.
Rest and stillness give sleep its fitted restorative function after the human-pair clause.
Covering with a garment makes night the concealing counterpart to exposed activity.
Livelihood gives day the sustaining counterfunction to sleep and nocturnal cover.

structural_cues: 78:6-13 coordinates earth/cradle, mountains/pegs, humans/pairs, sleep/rest, night/garment, day/livelihood, and lamp/blaze.
The first-person plural creative agent continues across the focus while the functions and forms change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent making clauses and their branch-defined functions; I infer that their coordination makes complementary fit the organizing arrow. A live alternative is that the sequence lists independent benefits without making them pairs.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports the isolated fact that humans occur in pairs.
changed_reading.after: Human pairing is the social embodiment of the same fitted complementarity by which the surrounding world supports life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garment occurrence immediately after the spouse-pair clause carries both covering and close association branches. It shades spousal joining as a relation of protective enclosure and shared presence, not only reproductive classification.

activation_trace.role: The spouse image anchors the changed reading in a human intimate relation.
Pairing one with another supplies the joining onto which the garment mechanism is mapped.
Covering with clothing supplies shelter and enclosure as a possible function of the joined relation.
Close association and social mixing connect the garment occurrence back to relational pairing.

structural_cues: 78:8-10 moves directly from your pairs to your sleep and then night as a garment, retaining the second-person plural human frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spouse/joining and covering/association images; I map the neighboring garment function onto the spouse bond as mutual shelter. The alternative is that night alone is covered and no spousal implication is intended.

changed_reading.before: Pairs names a biological or marital allocation.
changed_reading.after: Pairs can name an intimate joined relation whose function is mutual covering, nearness, and shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining is immediately followed by a branch of cutting and later by the Day that marks boundaries, separates partners, and removes mountains. Pair-bonds belong to a present order of relation; they are bounded rather than fused and can be separated or reclassified.

activation_trace.role: Joining one with another supplies the bond whose duration and limits are tested by the later cues.
Cutting and removal introduces interruption directly after the focus relation.
Separating things until their boundary appears supplies the decisive unbinding mechanism.
Parting from a partner in a shared matter applies separation specifically to a prior association.
Removal and displacement show that even the present order's stabilizing forms are not permanent.

structural_cues: The surah pivots at 78:17 from the ordered created world to the Day of Separation.
The mountains that function as pegs at 78:7 are moved and become mirage at 78:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, cutting, explicit separation, and removal; I infer a temporal arrow from current pairing to eventual differentiation. The alternative is that cosmic separation says nothing about human pair-bonds.

changed_reading.before: Created pairs are fixed, self-contained units.
changed_reading.after: Created pair-relations are real but provisional arrangements within the present order, answerable to later separation and sorting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branch-distant images align the spouse bond with emission, fluid in a womb, hidden gestation, human growth, and approaching birth. Against the explicit rain-to-plant sequence, paired creation becomes a generative cycle linking human reproduction to ecological emergence.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being anchors the proposed cycle in the focus act of creation.
The spouse image supplies the human generative relation.
Joining one with another supplies the causal coupling proposed by the reproductive model.
The branch image of emitted male fluid supplies an emission phase, while remaining distant from the local rain surface.
Male fluid in the womb supplies the transfer from paired joining to conception.
Human growth and rearing maps the explicit plant growth sequence back onto created humans.
A fetus hidden in the belly supplies gestation through the root's covering mechanism.
The womb branch supplies the containing site of the proposed generative chain.
Nearness of birth supplies the cycle's emergence phase while the surface occurrence denotes a near warning.

structural_cues: The focus on created pairs is followed at 78:14-16 by water, seed, growth, and enfolding gardens.
The same whole-surah packet later exposes womb and approaching-birth branch images at otherwise different surface senses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reproductive branch images but does not narrate this chain at their surface occurrences; I align them into a biological analogy and connect that analogy to spousal joining. The materially live alternative is the explicit ecological rain-to-growth sequence with no reproductive arrow.

changed_reading.before: Created pairs are a completed human arrangement.
changed_reading.after: Created spousal pairs can be read as the opening of an ongoing generative process: joining, fluid transfer, hidden growth, birth, and renewed human creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branches for kinds and action-sharing peers become visible as the surah gathers mixed plurality into groups, distinguishes transgressors from the self-protecting, registers membership, and arranges a final row. Azwaj can therefore anticipate affinity cohorts without making their moral condition innate.

activation_trace.role: Kinds and classes supply the focus-level capacity for more than dyadic pairing.
Peers grouped by shared action or condition supply the social mechanism later made explicit.
Mixtures gathered into one group supplies aggregation without requiring two-person units.
A group of people directly realizes collective arrival by cohorts.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies one shared condition by which a cohort is identified.
Entering a name in a register or cohort supplies formal classification rather than loose resemblance.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the contrasting shared disposition of the successful cohort.
Alignment on one level row supplies the final visible arrangement of a plurality by relation.

structural_cues: The plural cadence moves from أَزْوَاجًا at 78:8 to أَفْوَاجًا at 78:18.
78:22 and 78:31 introduce opposed human collectives before 78:38 stages an ordered row.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies class/peer branches and later group, condition, register, and row cues; I infer that later sorting actualizes one capacity of azwaj. I do not infer that creation predetermines moral membership; the alternative is that all later groupings are merely logistical.

changed_reading.before: Azwaj divides humanity only into male-female dyads.
changed_reading.after: Azwaj also opens onto human kinds and affinity cohorts whose shared actions or conditions become manifest in the final gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measuring branch of creation and counterpart branch of pairing expand into exact moral correspondence: action meets recompense, two things fit, measure equals its equivalent, all is counted, and like is set against like. Pairing becomes a law of answerability as well as a human arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the focus-side logic of exact fit.
Paired counterparts supply the relation later transferred from persons to acts and outcomes.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the action-outcome relation.
Two things fitting and coming together in agreement supplies explicit correspondence.
A measure equal to need or to its counterpart sharpens correspondence into proportion.
Counting and reckoning supplies the evaluative procedure behind proportionate outcomes.
Exhaustive enumeration prevents the matching mechanism from being approximate.
Setting like against like until they are equal supplies a final branch-level image of matched measure.

structural_cues: Punishment at 78:26 and reward at 78:36 are both introduced as recompense.
Reckoning at 78:27, exhaustive recording at 78:29, and the person's view of prior action at 78:40 create an evaluative sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measuring, counterparts, recompense, agreement, equality, and exhaustive count; I infer a common arrow in which an act receives its fitted counterpart. A live alternative is that wifaq describes punishment alone and does not reinterpret created pairs.

changed_reading.before: Pairing concerns only how humans are created in relation to one another.
changed_reading.after: Paired and proportioned creation also prefigures moral correspondence, in which each enacted condition meets a fitted outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equal-age companionship, a connection sustained between endpoints, and mutual facing sharpen counterpart pairing into reciprocity. The paired other is not merely an assigned category but a commensurate peer across a maintained relation.

activation_trace.role: Paired counterparts anchor parity in a relation between two matched sides.
Peers and associates grouped by likeness make social equality a live focus branch.
Equality in age and companionship directly sharpens the peer aspect of azwaj.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies relation without collapsing either side.
Things facing so each can see the other supplies reciprocity rather than one-sided possession.

structural_cues: The focus plural azwaj is answered by the explicit companionship plural atraban at 78:33.
The whole-surah close repeatedly stages relations between sides while preserving distinct agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peer equality, an inter-endpoint connection, and mutual facing; I infer that these specify how a counterpart relation may be reciprocal. The alternative is that atrab describes only the reward scene and does not qualify the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Pairing merely assigns one person to another, with no claim about the relation's quality.
changed_reading.after: One live dimension of created pairing is parity: distinct counterparts meet as commensurate companions across a reciprocal relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close moves from plural humanity to a singular person confronting what his own two hands advanced. This limits the cohort model: created relations and groupings situate the person, but they do not become the unit that acts or is reckoned.

activation_trace.role: Kinds and classes supply the collective reading that the closing singular grammar constrains.
Action-sharing associates supply the cohort mechanism without settling the unit of responsibility.
The individual man or woman supplies a singular human agent drawn out from the earlier plural group.
Advancing something forward supplies the person's own prior action entering the reckoning.
What the two hands earned locates agency in the individual's embodied deeds.

structural_cues: 78:8 addresses you in the plural, while 78:40 isolates al-mar' and then al-kafir in the singular.
The singular person is paired internally with dual hands, but the presented deed remains his own.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a plural-to-singular shift and the person's advanced handiwork; I infer that this corrects any reading in which the pair or cohort bears responsibility as one unit. The alternative is that the generic singular simply represents the same collective without stressing individuation.

changed_reading.before: Being created in a pair or affinity cohort determines the relevant human identity and outcome.
changed_reading.after: Pair and cohort relations are created settings for life, but each embodied person remains individually answerable for what he or she advances.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax most naturally distributes people into pairs, not organs within one body. It remains anchored in complete bodily proportion, the broad paired-counterpart branch, and the closing dual hands. Downstream prose should present it only as an embodied resonance of azwaj, not as a replacement for interpersonal pairing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَلَقْ can evoke completed proportioned form, and أَزْوَاجًا can include paired matching counterparts.

activation_trace.role: Complete and well-proportioned form supplies the body as the scale on which pairing might recur.
Paired counterparts broad enough to include matching objects permits an internal bodily application.
The bodily hand branch, realized in a dual surface form, supplies an explicit pair within the human form.

changed_reading.before: Pairs exist only between separate human beings.
changed_reading.after: Created pairedness may also echo within each proportioned body, whose matched hands become the instruments and evidence of individual action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it connects the two distinct ت ر ب branch senses of equal companions and dust to the focus's created kinds. It remains anchored in creation and the kind/peer branches of azwaj, with both context senses explicitly present. Downstream prose should call it a whole-surah material resonance, not an asserted etymological equation or final interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَلَقْ supplies created emergence, while أَزْوَاجًا supplies differentiated kinds and peer sets.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies emergence into differentiated human life.
Kinds and varieties supply the differentiation produced in created life.
Peers grouped by likeness connects differentiation to companionship rather than isolated taxonomy.
Equal age and companionship supplies a late image of matched human peers.
Earth and dust supplies the closing wish for undifferentiated materiality.

changed_reading.before: Creation into kinds and peers is a permanent differentiated state.
changed_reading.after: Created pairhood can be heard as contingent differentiation from common material, while the final dust-wish imagines the collapse of those human distinctions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because marriage, proposal, and connective speech are branch-distant from surface statements denying ownership of address and restricting speech. It remains anchored in the spouse and joining branches of azwaj, and the context branches form a coherent social mechanism of union by address and permission. Downstream prose should mark it as a latent institutional analogy, not claim that 78:37-38 locally discusses marriage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَزْوَاجًا activates both spousehood and the act of joining one person with another.

activation_trace.role: Spousehood supplies the human institution being reimagined through later address branches.
Joining one person with another supplies the relational act requiring social recognition.
Giving in marriage supplies an institutional act by which a spouse relation is authorized.
A marriage proposal supplies directed address as a step toward the joined relation.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the reciprocal medium of social joining.
Permission to act supplies the authorization boundary around relational speech.

changed_reading.before: Spousal pairing is only a biological status bestowed at creation.
changed_reading.after: A branch-level institutional echo treats pairing as a socially enacted joining through proposal, connecting speech, and authorized relation.

strongest_changes: The surrounding creation sequence enlarges human pairing into a system of fitted complementary functions.
The later afwaj, opposed conditions, register, and row activate azwaj as kinds and affinity cohorts, while the final singular person limits collective responsibility.
Recompense, agreement, equal measure, reckoning, and exhaustive enumeration turn counterpart pairing into a moral correspondence between action and outcome.
A contained branch-distant chain makes spousal pairing generative by aligning it with fluid, womb, hidden growth, and birth.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let the same short focus clause be tested against the ordered life-support sequence, the Day-of-Separation reversal, two outcome blocks, and the final singular reckoning. It also exposed coherent but non-surface branch chains that a local window would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not force a choice among spouses, sexual counterparts, broader complementary pairs, kinds, and peer groups.
The world-system reading depends on coordinated adjacency; the surrounding benefits are not explicitly called azwaj.
The reproductive cycle is exploratory because several activating branches are distant from their local rain, garden, divine-name, and warning surfaces.
Moral correspondence may be a local description of recompense rather than a backward reinterpretation of created pairing.
